The + 1 sizes the read buffer one byte past ErrorBodyMaxBytes: ReadAtLeastAsync either reaches the end of a body within the limit or fills that extra witness byte, and count > ErrorBodyMaxBytes then refuses the oversized body before JSON parsing, so a valid-looking prefix of an oversized envelope is never taken as complete. The 1 is that witness byte, not a policy value; the ErrorBodyMaxBytes limit itself stays open under RS-M6.
